script:
EMPTY_ROLE=$(control-agent-server conversation start --no-autotitle --tools none --print-id)
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$EMPTY_ROLE/events/count" --check . eq 0 --save F06.send-non-user-role-empty/before
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$EMPTY_ROLE/events" --json '{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"QA_F06_ASSISTANT_EMPTY"}]}' --expect 4xx --save F06.send-non-user-role-empty/post  # bug
